integrity: Self-review only; finite exact computations supplement and do not establish infinite-family formulas. No external or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two unordered particles on circular prisms with n>=5 only; rational representation module, not an integral lattice description; no integral quotient torsion claim. General proof relies on planar graph braid first-homology structure and explicit equivariant cellular traces. Novelty is not independently established against unindexed sources.
title: Complete rational dihedral and layer-exchange homology of two-point prism configurations
